question: What is the name of the gallery inaugurated by President Droupadi Murmu on Vijay Diwas 2025 at Rashtrapati Bhavan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Param Vir Dirgha.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **President Droupadi Murmu inaugurated the Param Vir Dirgha gallery at Rashtrapati Bhavan on Vijay Diwas 2025.**
 
• **The gallery displays portraits of all 21 Param Vir Chakra awardees.**
 
• **The initiative honours India’s bravest soldiers who made supreme sacrifices for the nation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Occasion:** Vijay Diwas (December 16).
 
• **Location:** Rashtrapati Bhavan, New Delhi.
 
• **Purpose:** Educate visitors about Param Vir Chakra awardees and inspire patriotism.
 
• **Symbolism:** Replaces portraits of British ADCs, reflecting decolonisation of national memory.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Param Vir Chakra:** India’s highest military gallantry award.
 
• **Vijay Diwas:** Marks India’s victory in the 1971 Indo-Pak War and creation of Bangladesh.
 
• **Theme:** Valour, sacrifice, national pride and military heritage.
